# E-PM2 card-loaded film simulations, films-look-exif

The owner reports film simulations loaded from the card work in the pinned build, with names in EXIF.

**Camera:** [Olympus PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md) · **Project:** [EPM2Mod](../projects/epm2mod.md)

**Firmware:** [E-PM2 firmware 1.6, build 1600](../firmware/epm2-1600.md) · **Mod build:** films-look-exif

In build films-look-exif, film simulations loaded from the card into the ART entries render as fitted on the owner's E-PM2 and record the film's name in the photo.

**Availability:** candidate. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [E-PM2 films-look-exif: owner camera test](../evidence/epm2-films-look-exif.md) — physical camera; reported pass; complete report; reported hash.

## Limits

- Built into installer pre-release v2026.11.20-rc.1; not a final release.
- Filter Type and Add Effects with a film simulation are untested.
